text:
To have Hermes Agent forward images or media produced by an MCP tool to platforms like Telegram, format the MCP tool output to reference the generated file using the **`MEDIA:<path>`** tag.

According to Hermes Agent's file & media delivery configuration:
* Outbound files and MCP `MEDIA:<path>` tags are delivered natively across messaging platforms (including Telegram media, Matrix `m.file`, Email attachments, etc.).
* Have your MCP server save the image locally to disk and return the path using the `MEDIA:<path>` format (for example, `MEDIA:/path/to/image.png`). Hermes Agent will recognize this tag and send the image directly to Telegram.
